data.value: Two dossiers form a pair when one has as customer the SIREN in the other's company profile, with at least one issued invoice in the last twelve months.

data.name: Intercompany.Rule.Pairs
data.value: A pair: the seller invoiced the buyer (customer SIREN equal to the one in the other dossier's company profile) in the last twelve months. Issued invoices and down payments, net of credit notes.

data.name: Intercompany.Rule.Matching
data.value: Each invoice looks for the buyer's transfer to the seller's IBAN: first the one whose label carries its number, otherwise a transfer of the same amount. A transfer pays only one invoice.

data.name: Intercompany.Rule.Purchases
data.value: Received invoices are not recorded in Lettra yet: the buyer's side is its supplier record and its bank.

data.name: Intercompany.Rule.Rights
data.value: Only the dossiers you can read are reconciled. Statement IBANs are never kept in clear: they are recognised by their fingerprint.
